record.question: What is plasmin, and what is its role in thrombolysis?
options: An enzyme that promotes clot formation.
An enzyme that breaks down fibrin, dissolving blood clots.
record.explanation: Answer C: An enzyme that breaks down fibrin, dissolving blood clots.. Plasmin is the active fibrinolytic enzyme that cleaves fibrin in clots. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/bodyct. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
